name: clusters
description: Four concepts, four paraphrases each, deliberately worded so no two paraphrases of the same concept share vocabulary. This is what the prompt asks for by name ('died after a week', 'won't hold a charge' and "battery's useless" all map to one battery-life theme) and what the heuristic engine's keyword matcher cannot do. Two clusters are fault-toned and two praise-toned so clustering is measured under both polarities. Each review mentions exactly one concept, so same-cluster and cross-cluster pairs are unambiguous.

clusters.durability: physical build holding up over time

reviews.text: It died after a week and never powered on again.
Simply will not hold a charge for more than an hour.
Have to plug it in twice a day, which defeats the point.
Runs flat unbelievably quickly compared to my old pair.
Cracked right across the housing within a month of light use.
The whole thing feels flimsy, like it would give way if you sat on it.
The hinge snapped clean off while I was putting it away.
Fell apart at the seam after barely any handling at all.
The highs are crisp and every instrument sits exactly where it should.
Bass is rich without ever drowning out the vocals.
Audio reproduction is superb, easily the best I have owned.
Everything comes through clean and detailed, even at low volume.
Wonderfully comfortable, I forget I am wearing them.
The cushions are soft enough for an eight hour shift.
Fits my head perfectly with no pressure anywhere.
Can keep these on all day without any ache at all.
